NetId.description: Identifier of the net (Id) connected to the pin in the list of nets. "-1" – not connected to any net.

Id.description: Bus Connector identifier (Id) in the schematic.

Sheet.description: Number of the sheet (Id), where Bus Connector is placed (4.1.4.1.1).

Group.description: Number of the group (Id), to which a Bus Connector belongs, see <Groups> section. "-1" – does not belong to any group.

GndNetId.description: Identifier of the net (Id) in the list of schematic nets (4.8), selected as "GND Net".

Plotted.description: The signal in the display list is:

text_content.description: The name of signal displayed in the list of signals.
